title: More Than Enough Time
about: A song built from affirmations centered on time and perspective.
description: Many people feel constant pressure from the belief that there is never enough time. This song reframes that perspective by encouraging a calmer mindset where time is abundant and manageable.
lyrics: Verse 1 – Rest
I am deeply rested every day
Rest comes easily, naturally my way
My body knows just how to recharge
My nights are calm, my sleep is large
I sleep peacefully, wake up refreshed
Clear and light, I feel my best
My nervous system soft and aligned
Perfect rhythm in body and mind
My body releases stress as I rest
My mind and body relax, nothing pressed
I am safe to fully let go tonight
My days end peaceful, my nights restore my light
Chorus
I always get the rest I need
My energy renews itself in me
My mind is clear, my time is kind
I’m rich in rest, I’m rich in time
Life supports me, I move with ease
Strong and calm, and free to breathe
Everything works in perfect design
More than enough rest, more than enough time
Verse 2 – Mental Capacity
My mind is clear, strong, and balanced
Spacious and open, calm and grounded
My thoughts support me, serve my way
I process everything with ease each day
I stay calm and steady under pressure
Mental energy, endless measure
Resilient, stable, clear and bright
My mind stays peaceful even in the height
My mental energy renews itself
I’m strong without forcing, gentle with myself
I easily manage all that comes through
My mind expands instead of straining through
Chorus
I always get the rest I need
My energy renews itself in me
My mind is clear, my time is kind
I’m rich in rest, I’m rich in time
Life supports me, I move with ease
Strong and calm, and free to breathe
Everything works in perfect design
More than enough rest, more than enough time
Verse 3 – Free Time
I have abundant free time now
My days feel spacious, unhurried how
My schedule open, flexible, free
I always have time for what matters to me
I move at my pace, I live my rhythm
My life supports free time within them
I wake up with time on my side
My evenings open, my joy unhidden
I have time to grow, to build, to create
Time to meditate, to train, to elevate
My time works for me, my days feel right
My life makes space for joy and light
Final Chorus
I always get the rest I need
My energy renews itself in me
Clear in my mind, calm in my way
Time flows easily every day
I’m supported by life, in perfect alignment
Strong and steady, no confinement
More than enough, in every sign
More than enough rest
More than enough time
